Plot national population or births metrics

Source: R/plot.population_metrics.R
plot.cd_population_metrics.Rd

Generates a line graph to visualize national-level demographic data, comparing DHIS-2 data/projections against UN estimates. This function is restricted to national-level data.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cd_population_metrics'
plot(
  x,
  metric = c("population", "births", "under1"),
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  x_title = NULL,
  y_title = NULL,
  legend_title = NULL,
  ...,
  legend_labels = NULL,
  options = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A cd_population_metrics object containing national-level demographic data.

metric

A character string specifying the type of data to plot. Must be one of:

  • 'population': Total population estimates (in thousands).

  • 'births': Total live births (in thousands).

  • 'under1': Population under 1 year of age (in thousands).

title

The chart's title.

subtitle

The line under the title.

caption

The note under the chart.

x_title

The title of the horizontal axis.

y_title

The title of the vertical axis.

legend_title

The title of the legend.

...

Chart options by name (see cd_chart_options()): background, fonts, sizes, axes, grid, legend, colours. Other arguments are ignored.

legend_labels

Optional. A character vector of custom labels for the legend items. Must match the number of lines plotted for the selected metric:

  • 'population': 2 labels

  • 'births': 3 labels

  • 'under1': 2 labels

options

A cd_chart_options() object or a list of chart options: a look made once, to give to several charts. Applied after the text arguments, so a text it holds wins over them.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

The function compares local Health Management Information System (DHIS-2) data with United Nations (UN) estimates.

Default Configuration:

  • Population: Compares un_population vs totpop_dhis2.

  • Births: Compares un_births vs totlivebirths_dhis2 vs totbirths_dhis2.

  • Under 1: Compares un_under1 vs totunder1_dhis2.

Examples

cache <- load_cache_data(system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core"))
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah
cache$set_national_estimates(list(sbr = 0.02))
cache$adjust_data()
population <- cache$denominator_metrics

plot(population, metric = "population")

plot(population, metric = "births", title = "Births: DHIS2 and the UN", y_title = "Thousands",
     legend_labels = c("UN live births", "DHIS2 live births", "DHIS2 births"))
